builds_on: taskctl.py auto-pickup / taskctl.py guard / taskctl.py stage pipeline

context7_usage.reason: Pure repo-local spec: command templates for already-known CLI tools (claude, codex), safety gates from existing env-contract, and completion path from existing taskctl.py + completion_inbox.py. No external MCP-SDK/API question open.

summary: Drafted a dryrun-only protocol for MCP-driven model autolaunch. Defines per-model command templates (claude_cli, codex_cli, deepseek_manual), four mandatory safety gates (env dual-gate, taskctl guard, allowed_writes enforcement, LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED=false), a 15-field log/usage/accounting schema, and the completion return path from worker write -> taskctl review -> completion_inbox -> Codex finalize. No actual CLI launch code exists; every launch_authority flag is false. Artifact size: <10KB JSON, well under 25MB limit.

section_1_command_templates.title: Per-Model CLI Command Templates
section_1_command_templates.description: Exact command-line templates for each supported agent adapter. Templates are dryrun-only documentation; no template is executed by this spec or by the current MCP server code.

claude_cli.completion_poll: poll taskctl.py show <task_id> for lifecycle_state=review; then completion_inbox.py reports review_queue

codex_cli.completion_poll: poll taskctl.py show <task_id> for lifecycle_state=review; then completion_inbox.py reports review_queue

deepseek_manual.template:
გაუშვი: python3 AITools/taskctl.py auto-pickup --runner <runner> --topic <topic>
და შემდეგ იმუშავე task-ზე. დასრულების შემდეგ: python3 AITools/taskctl.py review <task_id>
deepseek_manual.completion_poll: manual: owner copies command block to DeepSeek chat, worker reports back via taskctl.py review

section_2_safety_gates.title: Mandatory Safety Gates (4-layer)
section_2_safety_gates.description: Every model autolaunch MUST pass ALL four gates before a process is spawned. Gates are checked in order; failure at any gate blocks the launch and records a blocked_launch entry.

gates.name: Environment Dual-Gate
gates.note: Mirrors launch_queue_contract.py ALLOW_LAUNCH_ENV / ALLOW_WRITES_ENV. Both must be explicitly set to '1' by the owner.

gates.name: Taskctl Guard Check
gates.note: Ensures the task is still in a launchable state (not already claimed by another runner, not stale, not blocked).

gates.name: Allowed Writes Pre-Flight
gates.check: Verify task card allowed_writes are non-empty, within repo boundaries, and do not include forbidden paths (runtime/, registry/, defaults/)
gates.note: Each adapter receives only its task's allowed_writes as writable paths. Any write outside this set is a post-hoc violation caught by taskctl.py guard-staged.

gates.name: LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED Toggle
gates.check: LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED constant in launch_queue_contract.py is True before any real launch
gates.note: This spec is dryrun-only. G4 will remain FAIL until a future implementation task sets LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED=True and wires real process-spawn code.

section_3_log_usage_accounting.title: Log, Usage, and Accounting Schema
section_3_log_usage_accounting.description: Every autolaunch attempt records a structured log entry with these 15 fields. The log is append-only JSONL stored at tools/geoai-task-mcp/data/audit/mcp_autolaunch_log_b276_v1.jsonl.

fields.launch_id: UUID v4, unique per launch attempt
fields.model: model identifier string (e.g., claude-sonnet-4-5, gpt-5.5, deepseek-v4-pro)
fields.launch_requested_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when launch was requested
fields.launch_completed_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when process exited (null if still running/stale)
fields.exit_code: integer process exit code (null if still running)
gates_failed: list of gate ids that blocked launch
fields.error_message: string, last stderr line or exception message if launch failed
fields.stale_detected_at: ISO-8601 UTC, set when stale_timeout exceeded without completion

section_4_completion_return_path.title: Completion Return Path
section_4_completion_return_path.description: After a worker finishes its task, the completion flows back to Codex review through this deterministic path.

steps.action: Run task validation (shell test + taskctl.py verify)

steps.verification: task appears in review_queue[] with validation_status

steps.action: Review worker output: check allowed_writes, run taskctl.py guard-staged, validate artifacts
If PASS: taskctl.py stage <task_id> && taskctl.py guard-staged <task_id> && git commit. If FAIL: create repair task.

invariants.no_auto_commit_by_worker: Workers prefer NO_COMMIT; Codex finalizes allowed_writes only
invariants.no_git_add_A: Never git add -A or git add .; use explicit path staging
invariants.no_mixed_task_commit: One commit per task; never sweep unrelated dirty files

section_5_authority_flags.title: Authority Flags (ALL FALSE)
section_5_authority_flags.description: Every authority flag is explicitly false. This spec grants zero runtime, default, support, model, or score authority.

invariants.neural_routing_note: Model/adapter selection (claude_cli vs codex_cli vs deepseek_manual) must eventually become a learned neural routing decision per neural-control-first doctrine. The static adapter map in this spec is a human-configured safety boundary, not intelligence. Future neural routing targets are tracked in mcp_neural_launch_routing_migration_b254_v1.
